Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    sep=8
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sepr=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]==sep for c in range(W))]

    rb=[-1]+sepr+[H]; cb=[-1]+sepc+[W]
    bands=[(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    colsb=[(cb[i]+1,cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
    def cellshape(bi,cj):
        r0,r1=bands[bi]; c0,c1=colsb[cj]
        return [(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c]!=0]
    nb=len(bands); nc=len(colsb)
    occ={}
    for bi in range(nb):
        for cj in range(nc):
            s=cellshape(bi,cj)
            if s: occ[(bi,cj)]=s
    fills=[]
    for bi in range(1,nb):
        for cj in range(1,nc):
            if (bi,cj) in occ: continue
            tl=(bi-1,cj-1)

import json
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    def find_sep():
        for c in range(1,10):
            if any(all(g[r][i]==c for i in range(W)) for r in range(H)) and any(all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(H)) for j in range(W)):
                return c
    sep=find_sep()
    sepr=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]==sep for c in range(W))]
    sepc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    rb=[-1]+sepr+[H]; cb=[-1]+sepc+[W]
    bands=[(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    colsb=[(cb[i]+1,cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
    def cellinfo(bi,cj):
        r0,r1=bands[bi]; c0,c1=colsb[cj]
        pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c]!=0]
        return pts
    nb=len(bands); nc=len(colsb)
    occ={}
    for bi in range(nb):
        for cj in range(nc):
            s=cellinfo(bi,cj)
            if s: occ[(bi,cj)]=s
    fills=[]
    for bi in range(1,nb):
        for cj in range(1,nc):
            if (bi,cj) in occ: continue
            tl,tr,bl=(bi-1,cj-1),(bi-1,cj),(bi,cj-1)
            if tl in occ and tr in occ and bl in occ:
                cols={v for _,_,v in occ[tl]}|{v for _,_,v in occ[tr]}|{v for _,_,v in occ[bl]}
                if len(cols)!=1: continue  # L must be a single object/color
                Lr=bands[bi][0]-1; Lc=colsb[cj][0]-1
                for r,c,v in occ[tl]:
                    rr,cc=2*Lr-r, 2*Lc-c
                    if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: fills.append((rr,cc,v))
    for r,c,v in fills: g[r][c]=v
    return g

    nb,nc=len(bands),len(colsb)

def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep=next(c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]==c for r in range(H)))
    sepcol=sep
    # find sep value = most common full line value
    srows=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(grid[r]))==1]
    scols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[0][c] for r in range(H)) and len(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(H)))==1]
    sepv=grid[srows[0]][0] if srows else None
    sr=[-1]+srows+[H]; sc=[-1]+scols+[W]
    bands=[(sr[i]+1,sr[i+1]) for i in range(len(sr)-1)]
    cols=[(sc[i]+1,sc[i+1]) for i in range(len(sc)-1)]
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells={}
    for bi in range(len(bands)):
        for cj in range(len(cols)):
            r0,r1=bands[bi]; c0,c1=cols[cj]
            px=frozenset((r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0,sepv))
            colset={grid[r][c] for r,c in px}
            cells[(bi,cj)]=(px,colset)
    NB,NC=len(bands),len(cols)
    def rel(px,bi,cj):
        r0,c0=bands[bi][0],cols[cj][0]
        return frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in px)
    fills={}
    for bi in range(NB-1):
        for cj in range(NC-1):
            ks=[(bi,cj),(bi,cj+1),(bi+1,cj),(bi+1,cj+1)]
            nonempty=[k for k in ks if cells[k][0]]
            if len(nonempty)!=3: continue
            empty=[k for k in ks if not cells[k][0]][0]
            colsets={frozenset(cells[k][1]) for k in nonempty}
            if len(colsets)!=1: continue   # pure-color L only
            col=list(colsets[0])[0]
            er,ec=bands[empty[0]][0],cols[empty[1]][0]
            er1,ec1=bands[empty[0]][1],cols[empty[1]][1]
            h=er1-er; w=ec1-ec
            cands=[]
            for k in nonempty:
                dr,dc=empty[0]-k[0],empty[1]-k[1]
                rp=rel(cells[k][0],*k)
                if dr==-1 and dc==0:   # empty above source: vflip
                    f=frozenset((h-1-r,c) for r,c in rp)
                elif dr==1 and dc==0:
                    f=frozenset((r,c) for r,c in rp)  # placeholder
                    f=frozenset((h-1-r,c) for r,c in rp)
                elif dr==0 and dc==-1 or dr==0 and dc==1:
                    f=frozenset((r,w-1-c) for r,c in rp)
                else:  # diagonal
                    f=frozenset((h-1-r,w-1-c) for r,c in rp)
                cands.append(frozenset((er+r,ec+c, ) for r,c in f))
            if all(c==cands[0] for c in cands):
                fills[frozenset(cands[0])]=col
    for (px),col in fills.items():
        for r,c in px: g[r][c]=col
    return g

def cand_fill(cells, ei, ej, h, w):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter()
    k=min(b for b,_ in cells); l=min(c for _,c in cells)
    H,W=2*h,2*w
    for (bi,bj),(px,colr) in cells.items():
        if (bi,bj)==(ei,ej) or not px: continue
        lb,lc=bi-k,bj-l
        tr={'rot180':lambda r,c:(H-1-(lb*h+r),W-1-(lc*w+c)),
            'hmirror':lambda r,c:(lb*h+r,W-1-(lc*w+c)),
            'vmirror':lambda r,c:(H-1-(lb*h+r),lc*w+c)}
